name: Klein Anime / Realistic Slider
description: This LoRA can either make a realistic scene into an anime style one, or make an anime image into a photorealistic one. Works both in I2I and T2I. Note: This is a concept LoRA, not a style LoRA. The model knows what an anime is, the LoRA just plays on these weights. The training dataset does not contain any anime images. The sample weights range from 0 to 8 (full effect). The last sample is a anime image generated in T2I and made realistic in I2I with negative (-7) slider weight. Hope you like it!
